description: This header file provides utility functions for file and property management within a C++ project. It includes functions to read properties from files, read file contents, check file types, perform recursive file searches with pattern matching, and expand property variables within strings.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a specific property value from a given file, supporting recursive expansion if the property value references another property.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Recursively searches for files matching patterns within directories, with exclusions and result limit.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates a recursive file search based on input path, depth, exclusions, and collects matching files.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Processes a string to replace variables (denoted by '$') with their corresponding property values from a file.
